title: Paired Gaussian torus map
statement: For a natural number $n$, define a map from pairs $(z,w)$ of vectors in $\bbr^n$ to the torus indexed by $(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\{0,1\})\sqcup(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\{0,1\})$ by applying the Gaussian torus map to $z$ on the first summand and to $w$ on the second.
caveat: The snippet does not specify the Gaussian torus map itself.
